integrity: General proof independently reconstructed; witness checker tested q=2..8; integer-flow check q=2,3,4; finite checks do not establish the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary length-three palindrome covering cycles only; no length-five or longer, no linear optimality, and no classification of all optimizers. Earlier equivalent descriptions may have escaped inspection. Relevant 2006 paper has a verified year but no verified public release day; 2013-04-10 is the earliest day-verified cited methodological source.
title: Shortest cyclic covers of all length-three palindromes
